integrity: The proof uses published necessary conditions and an exact rational-arithmetic Sturm certificate. No numerical root approximation is needed for the theorem.
scientific_limitations: The conclusion fixes the normalized Alexander polynomial and the possible high elliptic surgery slopes, but it does not identify the knot up to isotopy or prove existence of any additional surgery. The finite Sturm enumeration is specific to genus \(6\).
title: Genus-six Alexander rigidity above the elliptic-surgery threshold
